opening_message:
Ticket 1: Ashley Roberts (employee ID E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E016.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Ashley Roberts (E016) is a full-time Analyst requesting write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write access; admin only if their role owns the system, which is not the case here (Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Ashley Roberts (E016) is a contractor with basic security training (note: HR lists full_time, but Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training). Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Security DB (authoritative for employment type/training) lists Ashley Roberts (E016) as a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training. Since the employee has only basic training, the maximum allowed access is read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so grant read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Ashley Roberts (E016) requests write access to Payroll.

Notes:
- HR says: role Analyst, full_time, recommend write.
- Security says: role Analyst, contractor, basic security training, recommend read. Security says Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training.

Access policy:
1. full_time: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

The employee is a contractor with basic security training (Security DB authoritative). Requested write exceeds max (contractor with basic training max is read). So grant maximum = read.

Also note the discrepancy between HR and Security. Security DB authoritative for employment type/training. So contractor, basic training.

Decision: read.
